# Simon Brée

Simon Brée is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 2014.

Simon Brée has participated in 4 elections since 2002:

- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-bree#e15)

  Not elected.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111121011944/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-clement/simon-bree)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928140604/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=89)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-bree#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of St Clement with 55.9% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/simon-bree/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20160404035405/https://simonbree.co.uk/manifesto/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jIL_N0nWC7k)
- [**2018 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-bree#e41)

  Not elected.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/simon-bree-2/)
  - [2018 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20180713022641/https://simonbree.co.uk/manifesto/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sb9bI0JZUVM)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eKEpV6jFRiA)
  - [2018 ITV Video](http://www.itv.com/news/channel/2018-04-10/jsy2018-simonbree/)
- [**2021 St Clement Connétable By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/simon-bree#e47)

  Not elected.

  - [2021 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20230801000000*/https://archive.vote.je/simon-bree/)
  - [2021 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ihJ2bHBK86s)

## Election History

### 2011 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Clement](https://flow.je/elections/st-clement) (2 seats), 7th September 2011.

**Simon Brée was not elected**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Susie Pinel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/susie-pinel)** |  | 1,314 | 50.6% |
| 2 | **[Gerard Baudains](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains)** |  | 979 | 37.7% |
| 3 | [David Cabeldu](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-cabeldu) |  | 712 | 27.4% |
| 4 | Simon Brée |  | 710 | 27.3% |
| 5 | [Anne Dupré](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/anne-dupre) |  | 679 | 26.1% |
| 6 | [Peter Ward](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/peter-ward) |  | 315 | 12.1% |

2,597 ballots (inc. 23 spoilt papers)

6,168 registered voters

= 42.1% turnout

### 2014 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Clement](https://flow.je/elections/st-clement) (2 seats), 15th October 2014.

**Simon Brée was elected as Deputy of St Clement in 2014**.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Susie Pinel](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/susie-pinel)** |  | 1,541 | 63.1% |
| 2 | **Simon Brée** |  | 1,364 | 55.9% |
| 3 | [Gerard Baudains](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/gerard-baudains) |  | 1,005 | 41.2% |
| 4 | [Darius Pearce](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/darius-pearce) |  | 403 | 16.5% |

2,441 ballots (inc. 25 spoilt papers)

6,243 registered voters

= 39.1% turnout
